scope: Sanitized summary of previously saved candidate receipts. Not a fresh full-suite run, not current owner acceptance, and not proof of a newly rebuilt package after documentation changes.

evidence_origin.raw_logs: Retained locally; not included because they contain host-specific details.
evidence_origin.independent_reproduction: Run the checked-in test suite and acceptance procedures on the intended release artifact. Receipt digests identify local evidence; summaries alone do not reproduce it.

saved_test_receipts.name: native-tests.xml
saved_test_receipts.scope: Native Windows subset, not the complete suite

saved_execution_evidence.windows_clean_install_and_reinstall: passed in isolated scratch locations; normal consumer path not accepted
saved_execution_evidence.authenticated_hermes: earlier dev3 only; does not establish dev6 acceptance
saved_execution_evidence.browser: disposable-browser interaction only; signed-in-session acceptance remains pending

pending_acceptance: Owner-present Windows UAC approval, real elevated command/job, cleanup and OFF
Approved signed-in browser access with profiles and logins preserved
Authenticated dev6 agent to machine MCP to real tool call to OFF and exact restoration
Complete transitive and platform-specific dependency license/redistribution/telemetry review
Broader native Windows CI coverage for machine/admin functions
Final artifact rebuild, hashes and normal downloaded-installer/first-launch/shortcuts/OFF acceptance
Physical Mac installation, TCC attribution, desktop use and restoration before supported Mac distribution
Signing/notarization or explicit unsigned-alpha distribution scope
Owner approval for new release publication

unchanged_boundaries.openclaw: local machine MCP binding implemented with native schema/policy validation; default .openclaw layout only on Linux/WSL/macOS, not native Windows or remote nodes
unchanged_boundaries.off: revokes Ballz-managed access and restores saved configuration; not undo of completed tasks, detached descendants, unrelated agents or OS permission grants
